name: Blue Pain
source: A vivid sky-blue flower, the form of a beloved person. Matsu Riese saw a scene he should have forgotten in a dream.  From that moment, Matsu's life begins to spiral out of control once more. His spirit crumbles amidst agonizing days.  In the darkness he cannot escape no matter how he struggles, Matsu faces a certain fate…
translation: 鲜艳的天蓝色花朵，是心爱之人的模样。马祖莉瑟在梦中看到了本该忘记的场景。从那一刻起，马祖的生活再次开始失控。他的精神在痛苦的日子里崩溃了。在黑暗中，无论如何挣扎都无法逃脱，马祖面临着某种命运……
